description.en: Attaches an avatar to a character with the standard "sysmes-Avatar-00001" message — a fixed-preset wrapper around RunAttachAvatarUseMsg.
Character ID to attach the avatar to.
Optional; whether to lock the avatar after attaching (defaults to true).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Attach and lock an avatar to a character with the standard presentation
RunAttachAvatar("para_cp0005", "ck0025");
